about: Raw tool outputs of the 4x RTX 4090 box (PCIe 4.0, no P2P, one NUMA node; EPYC 7502), captured 2026-11-25 for chapter 22's parser tests. Host names and user paths are replaced by <host> and <path>; nvidia-smi output keeps its ANSI escapes.

files.box_nvbandwidth.txt: nvbandwidth v0.11.0 -t host_to_device_memcpy_ce device_to_host_memcpy_ce host_to_device_memcpy_sm device_to_device_memcpy_read_ce (the last is waived: no peer access)
files.box_all_reduce_perf_g4.txt: nccl-tests v2.21.1 all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 256M -f 2 -g 4 -n 20 (NCCL 2.28.9 of the torch wheel)
files.doc_gdsio.txt: gdsio example output (commands and IoType lines) copied from NVIDIA, "Verifying GDS" (GPUDirect Storage for NVMe), https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/gds-support-for-nvme/latest/test-gds.html, retrieved 2026-11-25; documentation sample, not measured here
files.doc_nvswitch_node_topo_m.txt: nvidia-smi topo -m of an 8 x A100-SXM4-80GB node (NVSwitch, every GPU pair NV12; two NICs) copied from a user post on NVIDIA/nccl-tests issue 149, https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl-tests/issues/149, retrieved 2026-11-25; published sample (GitHub issue), not measured here
files.doc_bridged_pair_topo_m.txt: nvidia-smi topo -m of a 5-GPU workstation with A100 80GB PCIe cards, two of its pairs joined by NVLink bridges (NV12) and the rest over PCIe (PXB, SYS), copied from a user post on jax-ml/jax issue 11478, https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/issues/11478, retrieved 2026-11-25; published sample (GitHub issue), not measured here; not the 8-GPU bridged node of fig_lm_hw_server_graph
files.box_nccl_info_g4.txt: NCCL 2.28.9 INFO lines (NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=INIT,TUNING,GRAPH,ENV,COLL, written with NCCL_DEBUG_FILE) of nccl-tests v2.21.1 all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 256M -f 4 -g 4 -n 3 -c 1: the version, communicator, ring, tree, transport, channel, tuner-table and per-size choice lines, duplicates removed, host:pid:tid prefixes and comm pointers dropped
files.box_stream_16t.txt: STREAM 5.10 (stream.c, sha256 a52bae5e...; gcc 13.3 -O3 -fopenmp -mcmodel=medium -DSTREAM_ARRAY_SIZE=76000000 -DNTIMES=20, tools/build_hw_tools.sh), OMP_NUM_THREADS=16 OMP_PROC_BIND=spread OMP_PLACES=cores, CPU only, captured 2026-11-26 (four chapter-21 GPU jobs on the host, load average 6-11)
files.doc_ib_write_bw.txt: perftest ib_write_bw -a --report_gbits result table: a hand-written sample of the format (header and column layout of perftest 4.x; numbers made up, not measured, not copied), the same text as tools/test_lm_hardware.py's PERFTEST_BW; the box has no RDMA device
files.doc_ib_write_lat.txt: perftest ib_write_lat -a result table: a hand-written sample of the format (numbers made up, not measured), the same text as tools/test_lm_hardware.py's PERFTEST_LAT
files.doc_ibstat.txt: ibstat (rdma-core) output of one HDR InfiniBand adapter: a hand-written sample of the format, GUIDs zeroed, not measured; read by tools/hw_campaign/pack_t4.py's sample run (link layer)
files.doc_ib_write_lat_ionic.txt: perftest ib_write_lat result table of one 2-byte row (an AMD IONIC NIC), copied from a user post on uccl-project/uccl issue 707, https://github.com/uccl-project/uccl/issues/707, retrieved 2026-11-27; published sample (GitHub issue), not measured here; the latency parser's real-output test
files.doc_ib_write_bw_mbsec.txt: perftest ib_write_bw -D 10 -d mlx5_0 output without --report_gbits (RoCE, MB/sec columns, one 64 KiB row), copied from a user post on linux-rdma/perftest issue 234, https://github.com/linux-rdma/perftest/issues/234, retrieved 2026-11-27; published sample (GitHub issue), not measured here; the bandwidth parser must refuse it (the campaign runs ib_write_bw with --report_gbits)
